name: keystone-dashboard-layout-angular-examples
description: A real, standalone Angular CLI app (not part of the pnpm workspace, same as astro-docs) hosting live, deployable examples of keystone-dashboard-layout-angular — the intended replacement for embedding examples inline in astro-docs via @analogjs/astro-angular, which proved too fragile against this monorepo's specific Angular/vite-plugin-angular version combination.
